subject: Approval request: temporary H200 reservation + overage cap for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary H200 reservation + overage cap for Nimbus Health

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looks great for our batch inference jobs. We are close to signing but have one operational ask from procurement: they want a short-term SKU swap from our reserved A100 capacity to an H200 variant for the first 45 days of the commitment window, and an overage cap while we finish model reprovisioning.

Specifically:
- Swap 16 reserved A100 -> 16 reserved H200 for 45 days (then revert).
- Allow burst capacity up to +40% for 30 days with predictable overage capped at $7/GPU-hour during that window.
- Reservation hold: if we exceed our initial capacity while we finalize infra changes, put a 7-day reservation hold trigger so we avoid immediate billing spikes while we triage.

We understand this is nonstandard. What we need from Redwood is a short exec approval and a written note we can share with procurement for sign-off. Attached is the current proposal and our projected usage.

Claire
Claire Dawson
Head of ML Ops, Nimbus Health
Attachments: nimbus_proposal_v12.pdf (pdf), usage_chart_nov.csv (csv)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary H200 reservation + overage cap for Nimbus Health

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Looping you in — Nimbus (high-growth health SaaS) is asking for a temporary SKU swap to H200s for 45 days plus a short burst/overage cap window. Procurement wants a written exec approval to attach to their PO.

Key asks:
- 16x A100 -> 16x H200 for 45 days (then revert)
- Burst up to +40% for 30 days; overage cap ~$7/GPU-hour
- 7-day reservation-hold trigger to avoid billing shocks during migration

They've attached usage projections. From a risk perspective I think this is manageable if we set clear guardrails (auto-fallback to A100 after 45 days, strict burst quotas). Can we get deal desk thumbs-up + one exec sign-off? If yes I will send a one-paragraph confirmation to Claire to unblock procurement.

Also tagging for pricing: would a short-term overage cap at $6/GPU-hour (instead of their $7) with a 10% one-time pilot discount get this done faster?

-Michael
VP, Partnerships & Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary H200 reservation + overage cap for Nimbus Health

Michael / Marissa,

Thanks for the context. Reviewed the numbers and usage file. Recommended approval from Deal Desk side with these controls:
- Approve temporary SKU swap 16 A100 -> 16 H200 for 45 days with automated revert.
- Approve burst up to +40% for 30 days but cap overage billing at $6.00/GPU-hour for that period. After 30 days standard overage rates apply.
- Reservation hold: enable a 7-day automatic reservation-hold window triggered when actual spend > 125% of forecast in a rolling 48-hour window. During hold, throttle burst allocations and send a mandatory incident review.
- Apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first month's committed spend (to offset migration costs).

Attachments: internal_billing_guardrails.docx (internal) — I've summarized the guardrails and escalation steps.

If you approve, I can draft the short approval note for procurement and prep a DocuSign addendum for signatures. This keeps the commercial ask minimal while protecting Redwood from indefinite exposure.

Lauren
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@nimbushealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: temporary H200 reservation + overage cap (Nimbus Health) — Redwood exec confirmation

Claire,

Thanks for the note and the attachments. This message confirms Redwood's executive-approved exception for the Nimbus Health commitment with the following terms (summary for procurement):

1) Temporary SKU swap: 16 reserved A100 -> 16 reserved H200 for 45 days starting on the effective date of the amendment; automatic revert to original SKU at day 46.
2) Burst: up to +40% capacity for 30 days from amendment signature. Overage billing during the burst window capped at $6.00 per GPU-hour.
3) Reservation hold: a 7-day reservation-hold safeguard will be enabled if spend exceeds 125% of forecast over any rolling 48-hour window; during the hold, burst allocations are throttled and Redwood will engage Nimbus on next steps.
4) Credit: a one-time onboarding credit of 10% of the first month's committed spend applied to the first invoice.

Next steps for procurement:
- We will issue a short addendum for signature (DocuSign link below). Once signed, Redwood will schedule the SKU swap and enable the burst window on the agreed dates.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=0a1b2c3d
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

If procurement needs any clarifications, loop in the PM/infra contacts and we will expedite.

—Marissa Cole
